answer: We formalize Sybil resistance via a dynamic staking collateral function, where validators deposit tokens to generate a zero-knowledge verifiable delay path. This defines a parameter mesa of uniform security where any attempt to multiply identities triggers a subgame-perfect slashing penalty, driving the expected utility below zero.
